name: R016-ai-charm-clear-body
why: Challenge 2, where the AI runs AI_CheckBadMove. The opponent leads with Minun 292 (Thunderbolt, Attract, Charm, Wish); the player leads with Metang 311, whose only ability is Clear Body. On the first turn the AI scores Charm: AI_CBM_AttackDown reaches CheckIfAbilityBlocksStatChange and gives -10 (battle_ai_scripts.s:308-312). Torkoal 357 (White Smoke) is in the player's party too.
